description: This file defines the Menu class, which models a menu item in a web application's admin interface, including properties such as code, URL, icon, role, order, and nested menus. It implements Serializable and uses Jackson annotations for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Represents a menu item with properties like code, URL, icon, role, order, and nested sub-menus. Implements Serializable for object serialization.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the URL associated with the menu.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Assigns a URL to the menu.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Gets the icon associated with the menu.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the menu.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role associated with the menu.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Assigns a role to the menu.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the display order of the menu.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the display order of the menu.
